title: Counterparty exposure and currency exposure are separate concerns
context: A forward INCREASES counterparty exposure (credit to the bank) and REDUCES currency exposure (protects the foreign receivable). A combined figure would be meaningless in the best case and misleading in the worst.
decision: Two distinct tables (deal-derived vs currency_exposure), two distinct units (GBP pence vs foreign minor units + explicit currency), two distinct services (ExposureCalculator vs HedgeService). No query in the repository layer joins them. currency_exposure has no counterparty_id column at all — an obligation to a supplier is not an obligation to a bank.
consequences: backend/app/services/hedge_service.py file-level docstring is the canonical reference
There is no GET /exposure that returns 'total' — the API surface refuses to be asked
Exposure panel and Hedging panel are separate strip entries — never merged
